task: Fix DONE evidence recovery ordering so agents do not repeat stale refresh loops after deterministic main sync.
outcome: When a TEST story is near DONE and main/evidence freshness has drifted, the terminal shows a single ordered recovery command: lattice done_prepare {"storyId":"B-xxxx","mergeMain":true,"refreshStale":true,"validate":true}; after that passes, the user sees the normal story_advance DONE command instead of scattered git merge, validate, and done_required_validate hints.
facts: B-3523 lost time because DONE closure involved main/material binding drift and repeated manual evidence refresh.
done_prepare already performs the safe order: merge main first, classify/refresh stale evidence, run validate, check DONE closure, and never mutates version files before DONE.
done-effects intentionally runs version bump, packages/main build, and experience cache refresh after DONE merge on local main.
Existing docs explicitly say version mutation must stay out of done_prepare and pre-DONE readiness because it changes material hash.
Raw DONE gate hints still point to scattered commands for evidence freshness, done-required validation, and branch sync.
constraints: Do not weaken materialHash or storyFilesHash validation.
Do not move post-DONE version bump before DONE evidence.
Do not redesign DONE lifecycle or remove existing autoSyncMain safety.
Keep workflow commands host-neutral and agent-neutral.
Only fix the real recovery-ordering issue exposed by B-3523.
